changes.comment: SaferFetch.createGuardedFetch accepts an opt-in maxResponseBytes (no default): a declared Content-Length over it rejects the call with a 'too-large' GuardedFetchError, and any other body is returned wrapped in a counting stream that cancels the upstream and errors with a 'too-large' GuardedFetchError once the decoded byte count passes the cap. The body is still never read by the guarded fetch itself. A 'too-large' GuardedFetchError's message names maxResponseBytes and the limit.
